rows.author: E016
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE POWERS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL OIL COMPANY, FURTHER AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 334, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “CHARTER OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL OIL COMPANY”
rows.title_short: Strengthening The Powers And Functions Of The Philippine National Oil Company, Further Amending For The Purpose Presidential Decree No. 334, As Amended, Otherwise Known As The “charter Of The Philippine National Oil Company”
rows.abstract:
Grants the PNOC a franchise to develop, construct, own and operate pipelines and all other modes of transportation of conventional energy resources all over the country and to implement, by itself, through its subsidiaries or with other entities, a comprehensive and integrated program for all conventional energy resources.

Authorizes the Secretary of Energy, in concurrent capacity, to be the Ex-Officio Chairperson of the Board and its subsidiaries, provided, that no case shall the Secretary of Energy be the Chief Executive Officer or Chief Operating Officer of the company or its subsidiaries.

Mandates that the Chief Executive Officer or Chief Operating Officer shall be elected annually by the members of the Board from among its ranks; the President of the company shall have at least five (5) years of experience in oil, gas, or any energy-related industry; and the Corporate Secretary and the Vice Presidents shall be appointed by the Board.

Mandates that all contracts entered into, benefits enjoyed and obligation incurred by the Company shall remain valid, in force and in effect and shall be under the name of the Company from the effectivity of this Act.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A 30-YEAR NATIONAL INFRASTRUCTURE PROGRAM
rows.title_short: 30- Year National Infrastructure Program Act Of 2021
rows.abstract:
Provides the policies and strategies to be pursued by Government in order to develop the component national infrastructure projects.

Provides additional list and brief description of core national infrastructure projects to be given priority in the 30-Year Program. 

Mandates NEDA, in coordination with the Oversight and Implementing Agencies, to formulate the details of the 30-Year National Infrastructure Program, divided into six phases of five years each.

Mandates implementing agencies to formulate their Medium-Term Infrastructure Programs and Annual Infrastructure Budgets (AIBs) to be integrated into the National Expenditure Programs (NEPs) for submission to the Congress as basis of the General appropriations Acts (GAAs).

AN ACT ENSURING THE EFFECTIVENESS OF OFFICIAL DEVELOPMENT 
ASSISTANCE LOANS AND GRANTS, AMENDING FOR 
THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8182, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS 
THE OFFICIAL DEVELOPMENT ASSISTANCE ACT OF 1996, 
AS AMENDED
rows.title_short: Oda Effectiveness Act
rows.abstract:
ODA and Aid Effectiveness refers to a loan or loan and grant package which meets several criteria to be effective.  Intends to promote and achieve sustained reduction of poverty and inequality and support the enjoyment of human rights, democracy, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.  Seeks to require ODA loans to be based on democratic ownership and mutual accountability.  

Provides an alternative discount rate for computing the present value (PV) of debt service payments;  Seeks to empowers civil society organizations to measure the impact of effectiveness and establishes a citizen participation committee for each ODA-funded project.

rows.author: J071
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING A PHILIPPINE POLLUTANT RELEASE AND TRANSFER REGISTRY
rows.abstract:
Proposes to tally and study the scientific nature and details of pollutants, toxic chemicals, and substances so that they can be eliminated or be confined to avoid harming our health and our environment.
Defines several terms among others such as Green Chemistry, Clean Production, and Pollutant Release and Transfer Registry (PRTR) - refers to catalogs or registries of potentially harmful pollutant releases or transfers to the environment from a variety of sources, including information on the nature and quantity of such releases and transfers.  It includes information regarding releases or transfers to air, water, and soil; and wastes transported to treatment and disposal sites.  These are the means for obtaining regular, periodic information about releases and/or transfers of chemical substances of interest and for making this information accessible to those who may be interested and/or affected by it; it is a tool for promoting efficient and effective policies for environmental protection and sustainable development.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 2021-11-08

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE AQUARIUM AQUATIC LIFE TRADE AND INDUSTRY
rows.abstract:
Seeks to regulate the aquamarine aquatic life collecting industry by implementing prohibitions and a system of fines for violators.

Aims to protect and enrich the abundant marine biodiversity of the country in the long term while maintaining a sustainable harmony between economic livelihood and environmental protection.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AQUACULTURE AND FISHERIES RESOURCES since 2021-11-08

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 77 OF BATAS PAMBANSA BILANG 881 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to address the issue that substitution of election candidates in case of withdrawal of another (voluntary substitution) may pose confusion and might lead to the manipulation and mockery of the election process.
Seeks to reinforce Sec.69 of the Omnibus Election Code that states that a person can be declared a nuisance candidate if it is “shown that said certificate has been filed to put election process in mockery or disrepute”¦”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2021-11-08

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT REINSTATING AND AMENDING SECTION 67 OF BATAS PAMBANSA BILANG 881 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to reinstate the repealed provision regarding elective officials deemed resigned once they file their Certificate of Candidacy provided that they file for another position different from the ones they are currently holding.
Proposes that any elective national or local official, running for any office other than the one he is holding in a permanent capacity [except for President and Vice-President] shall be ipso facto automatically resigned from his office upon the filing of his COC.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2021-11-08

rows.author: H061
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO IMPROVE THE EFFICIENCY OF NATIONAL RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to establish under the Office of the President a Research and Development Support Committee (RDSC) who shall be responsible for reviewing regulations affecting research and research universities.
Proposes that RDSC shall harmonize, streamline, and eliminate duplicative regulations and reporting requirements; and minimize the regulatory burden on institutions of higher education performing government-funded research while maintaining accountability for expenditures.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY since 2021-11-08

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING THE UNBUNDLING OF PRICES IN THE SALE OF PETROLEUM PRODUCTS BY THE DOWNSTREAM OIL INDUSTRY IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Institutionalizes the unbundling of oil prices in the downstream oil industry in the Philippines in order to ensure a truly competitive market under a regime of fair prices through the liberalization and the deregulation of the local downstream oil industry.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10823

rows.author: I083
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SUBSTITUTION OF CANDIDATES BY REASON OF WITHDRAWAL THEREBY AMENDING SECTION 77 OF THE BATAS PAMBANSA BILANG 881 OR THE OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract:
Amends Section 77 of the Batas Pambansa Bilang 881 or the Omnibus Election Code of the Philippines by prohibiting the substitution of candidates by reason of withdrawal.

Also amends Section 69 of the same BP which states that any candidate who is only a placeholder for another candidate, is prima facie evidence that said candidate has no bona fide intention to run for the office for which the COC has been filed.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2021-11-08

rows.title_full:
AN ACT PROMOTING THE SCIENTIFIC PROPAGATION, PROCESSING, UTILIZATION AND
DEVELOPMENT OF PHILIPPINE NATIVE ANIMALS, HEREBY CREATING THE PHILIPPINE NATIVE ANIMAL DEVELOPMENT CENTER
rows.title_short: “ Philippine Native Animal Development Act"
rows.abstract: Proposes to create the Philippine Native Animal Development Center which shall be responsible for the conservation, propagation, and promotion of native animals in the country.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2021-11-08

rows.author: J071
rows.title_full: AN ACT PUNISHING THE WILLFUL FAILURE TO PAY CHILD SUPPORT
rows.abstract:
Proposes to recognize Section 194 of the Family Code of the Philippines which defines SUPPORT as that “comprises everything indispensable for sustenance, dwelling, clothing, medical assistance, education, and transportation, in keeping with the financial capacity of the family.”
Intends to give importance to the right of each child to be supported by their parents until such time that they will become self-sustaining.
Seeks to penalize the willful neglect of parent, child support that is adjudged by a court of justice in a decision, decree, or in any court order.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WELFARE OF CHILDREN since 2021-11-08

rows.author: J071
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING A DENTAL UNIT IN EVERY RURAL HEALTH UNIT UNDER THE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AS PART OF THE PRIMARY APPROACH IN THE DELIVERY OF HEALTH SERVICES AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Creates a specialized dental unit in every rural health unit that will give the communities their deserved professional health amenities.

Seeks to prevent and cure the prevalence of oral diseases such as the common complaints of dental cavities and periodontal diseases.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2021-11-08

rows.author: H046
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR COMPENSATION TO STAY-AT-HOME MOTHERS
rows.abstract:
Proposes to recognize the economic value of the domestic labor that stay-at-home/full-time mothers perform;  Entitles them to a monthly compensation of FIVE THOUSAND PESOS (Php5,000.00), whose family´s annual income falls below the country´s poverty threshold and who are noted gainfully employed.
Provides guidelines or conditions to qualify for such compensation per month.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WOMEN AND GENDER EQUALITY since 2021-11-08

rows.author: B010
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING BIKE-FRIENDLY COMMUNITIES
rows.title_short: “ Bike Friendly Communities Act”
rows.abstract:
Seeks to establish bike-friendly communities throughout the Philippines that will 1.) create a safe and easy environment for cycling; 2.) educate the community on bicycle safety and laws; and 3.) enforce rules and regulations surrounding traffic and marked lanes.

It also seeks to direct the Secretary of the Department of Transportation to develop a comprehensive plan and program to ensure the safety not only of cyclists, but also other commuters.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2021-11-08

rows.author: I020
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE CREATION OF AN OFFICE OF ARCHITECTURAL PLANNING AND DESIGN IN MUNICIPALITIES, CITIES, AND PROVINCES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS 38, 185, 227, 302, 443 (A) AND (B), 454 (A) AND (B), AND 463 (A) AND (B), 477, AND 485 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9640, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: Seeks to make the position of provincial, city, and municipal architects mandatory and further proposes that the building official be a separate position for the city and municipal engineers, or for that matter for the city and municipal architects.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2021-11-08

rows.author: I083
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE SAFE AND PHASED REOPENING OF SCHOOLS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
This bill seeks to provide the framework and funding for the safe and phased reopening of schools beginning from low-risk areas which shall cover all public and private educational institutions at all levels.

Mandates all local government units and concerned government agencies, together with the education stakeholders, to form a roadmap based on the actual needs and conditions in their respective localities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2021-11-08

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN INTER-GOVERNMENTAL TASK FORCE FOR THE PROTECTION AND ASSISTANCE OF TOURISTS
rows.title_short: “ Tourist Protection And Assistance Act”
rows.abstract: Proposes the creation of the Tourist Protection and Assistance Task Force which shall be responsible for the following: 1.) adoption of uniform standards on signages across the country; 2.) preparation of multilingual travel and tourism information and promotional materials; and 3.) establishment of an assistance system and help desks for tourists, among others.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TOURISM since 2021-11-08

rows.author: J071
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PUBLIC MATH AND SCIENCE HIGH SCHOOLS IN PREVIOUSLY UNDERSERVED AREAS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: “ Equitable Access To Math And Science Education Act”
rows.abstract: Aims to provide equitable access to quality education in the pure and applied sciences, mathematics, and technology thus the establishment of a specialized public high school across all provinces which do not have at least one public math and science high school operating within their geographical boundaries.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2021-11-08

rows.author: J071
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING HAZARD PAY TO WORKERS IN CRITICAL INDUSTRIES DURING A STATE OF CALAMITY OR EMERGENCY OR PUBLIC HEALTH EMERGENCY
rows.abstract: Proposes to cover all workers in critical industries in the private sector such as, but not limited to health-related establishments; morgues and mortuaries; financial institutions providing money transfers; food and medicines providers; logistics and warehouse establishment; telecommunications companies; mass media personnel delivering news; electric generation, transmission, and distribution companies; gasoline stations; oil companies (tanker drivers); water-related services; garbage collectors,  Phil. Capital market workers; hotels; mass public transportation companies; civil aviation-related companies; and other establishments may be considered critical in light of the nature of the state of calamity emergency or public health concern.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2021-11-08
